finding: The site is a set of parallel per-session dashboards, not one dashboard.
measured: 36 pack directories under docs/, 26 cards on the hub landing page, 21 cards on the root portal
why_it_matters_for_decisions: A reviewer comparing two packs has to open both, and the same question is answered differently on each. Decision cost grows with every pack.
suggested_action: T12 — name a canonical pack, keep the others as archive, move the shared registers (this board) to the landing page.

finding: The landing pages list overlapping but not identical pack sets.
measured: hub-only: nfl-309921cc, nfl-a411fed0, nfl-f4, nfl-market; root-only: nfl-e5e38f9e, nfl-wk; in both: 12
why_it_matters_for_decisions: The two entry points disagree about what exists. Anyone deciding from one page is deciding on a different repository than someone using the other.
suggested_action: Generate both card lists from one file (also removes a class of drift the link checker cannot see).

finding: The coordination board is no longer reviewable as a board.
measured: 3647 lines / 428,712 bytes bytes in COORDINATION.md, with 97 rows still marked in progress
why_it_matters_for_decisions: The takeover and de-duplication rules depend on reading the board. At this size nobody does, so work duplicates.
suggested_action: T14 — split into a live board plus an append-only archive; add the board-path checker.

finding: Every session wrote its own executive summary at the repository root.
measured: 19 executive-summary markdown files at root, 18 of them NFL-domain
why_it_matters_for_decisions: There is no single answer to 'where are we'. The owner's request for an executive summary is currently satisfied 17 different ways.
suggested_action: One current summary at root, per-session summaries moved to docs/archive/.

finding: The review backlog is a number, and it is published nowhere in aggregate.
measured: 238 flagged rows across 15 flag registers; blank-audit registers: 3
why_it_matters_for_decisions: The brief treats blanks as the most informative thing on the page; today they are distributed across packs and invisible.
suggested_action: Surface the aggregate on the landing page (this board does, per pack, in conflicts + gaps).

finding: Each pack added its own CI workflow.
why_it_matters_for_decisions: CI time and failure triage scale with pack count, and a green board can hide a pack nobody re-runs.
suggested_action: Collapse to one NFL workflow that runs every pack's build+check in a matrix.

finding: The repository mixes domains and one-off artefacts in the same root.
measured: non-NFL top-level artefacts present: RENTAL_INCREASE_SF_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md, nba_lab; root-level markdown files: 22
why_it_matters_for_decisions: A reviewer cannot tell what is in scope for the NFL programme, which is itself a decision the brief asks to be visible.
suggested_action: Move non-NFL and one-off files under docs/archive/ or their own top-level directory; decide in T12.

finding: No LICENSE file at the root while the site publishes third-party data.
why_it_matters_for_decisions: The data-rights ceiling (T01) and the code licence are different questions, and both are currently answered by silence.
suggested_action: Add a code licence plus an explicit data-rights statement per table (3b81013c S-10 already proposed it).

finding: Verification is asserted by each pack and cross-checked by none.
measured: 19 per-pack build/check script pairs; 6 shared checkers
why_it_matters_for_decisions: The same value is 'verified' in one pack and 'unverified' in another, which is how the board ends up re-litigating settled evidence.
suggested_action: One ledger of official reads with hashes (this pack's official_reads.csv is the pattern) that every verifier may cite.

finding: The site can prove a source URL exists but not that it said anything.
measured: registers carrying a source URL column: 23/27; retained raw text files: 19
why_it_matters_for_decisions: A link is not an evidence chain. Without retained text, tomorrow's reviewer cannot tell a misread from a changed source.
suggested_action: Keep the raw excerpt with its hash for every read the site cites (T03), including the 12 this session recorded.
